name: Personnel records remain private to their owner and support full CRUD
description: Verifies a user can create, retain, edit, and delete only that user’s personnel records using readable mobile-sized fields.
expected: The record survives refresh, edited values persist, the fields are usable on mobile, and confirmed deletion removes it.

name: Salary tax uses only the salary norm and excludes allowances
description: Verifies tax is calculated only from the selected salary norm/base amount and does not increase when non-taxable allowances are added.
steps: Select a supplied military salary norm
Add service, education, feeding and other allowances
Change an allowance while keeping the salary norm unchanged
Set absence days and review payable values
Set 4 months and review the complete table
Confirm the table stays within the mobile page width
expected: The tax amount depends only on the salary norm, allowances do not increase tax, the final salary includes the allowances, absence and multi-month totals calculate automatically, and the summary table fits the mobile viewport.

name: Persistent sign-in exit locks the device without signing out
description: Verifies system exit keeps the current email session, activates a local device lock when needed, and requires fingerprint/PIN on return; account switching remains the explicit sign-out path.
steps: Open the sidebar and choose the system-exit action
Verify Account A opens without email login
expected: System exit never calls sign-out; reopening uses device verification for Account A without email re-entry. Account switching separately requires confirmation and then signs out Account A.

name: Ordinary users cannot access another account’s data
description: Verifies User B cannot see or mutate User A records through normal application access.
steps: Sign in as User A and create a personnel record
Try to use the application to access User A data
expected: User B sees only User B records and cannot edit or delete User A records.

name: Safe refresh and color controls remain available
description: Verifies safe refresh, appearance controls and app-only display behavior remain available.
steps: Open the sidebar and tap 'معلومات تازه کول'
expected: The app refreshes without signing out, the chosen appearance remains available, and the app contains no embedded third-party frame or advertising surface.
